positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligenceAsset
positions.frame: when intelligence is owned rather than rented, where does the retained value actually sit — in the substrate or in the perspective?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional move: a plain-spoken antithesis (register mint AphoristicTechnicalMaxim) that reclassifies value from a commoditized base layer to a kept, owned layer (style mint CommoditySubstratePerspectiveAsset; power mint ReframeAsAsset). The relational read frames owned-vs-rented as a market-pricing proportionality axis, the value read grounds the same split in autonomy and self-enhancement/competence (value mint OwnershipAsValueAxis), and conviction sits both at unhedged 'claim' level with calm-positive settled affect (conviction mint OwnedNotRentedAssertion) — a staked thesis, not yet ratified as principle or decision. No tension between the two: src-2 opens the distinction, src-3 completes it by naming which side is the kept asset.
